annotation.title_clean: Nouvelle phase de la stratégie nationale d'intelligence artificielle : le Gouvernement fait le pari des talents (France 2030 : stratégie nationale pour l'intelligence artificielle)
annotation.title_en: New phase of the national AI strategy: the Government bets on talent (France 2030: national strategy for artificial intelligence)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Direction générale des Entreprises; Ministère de l'Enseignement supérieur, de la Recherche et de l'Innovation; Secrétariat d'État chargé de la Transition numérique
annotation.summary_en: French government press release (8 Nov 2021) announcing the second phase of the national AI strategy under France 2030, mobilising €2bn of public-private funding, mainly for talent, embedded and trustworthy AI, SME adoption and energy-frugal AI. Innovation-promotion focus with only passing mention of autonomous vehicles.
key_provisions_or_claims: €2bn co-financing: about €1.5bn public and over €500M private
Over half of public effort (€781M) devoted to AI talent and training
€1.22bn for embedded, responsible and trustworthy AI and development platforms
Confiance.ai programme to certify and secure critical AI systems, rising from €45M to €271M
Support for 500 SMEs/mid-caps in AI adoption by 2025; aligned with revised EU Coordinated Plan on AI
